# Edwin Garage (SG Garage)

> Edwin Garage Aircon & Car Repair, also known as SG Garage, is an owner-operated car repair and servicing workshop in Ang Mo Kio, Singapore, serving drivers since 2010. It handles car servicing, mechanical repair, car aircon repair and accident claim repair, by online appointment. Rated 4.9 stars from 600+ Google reviews.

Last updated: 2026-11-14
Canonical website: https://www.sggarage.com/

## Key facts

- Business name: Edwin Garage Aircon & Car Repair
- Also known as: SG Garage, SGGarage, Edwin Garage
- Registered company: Edwin Garage Automotive Services Pte. Ltd. (UEN 201828727D)
- Serving drivers since: 2010
- Address: Blk 5032 Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 #01-295, Singapore 569535
- Aircon unit: SG Garage, Blk 5032 Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 #01-309, Singapore 569535 (car aircon work only: gas top-up after a leak check, leak checks, compressor, cooling coil, condenser, odour)
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm; closed Sunday
- Booking: by appointment only, online at https://sggarageedwin.as.me/ (no walk-ins)
- Enquiries: WhatsApp +65 9785 6612 (enquiries only, not bookings)
- Google rating: 4.9 stars from 600+ reviews: https://share.google/hYkZhnKyoAEeERhWM
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/edwingarageamk/
- Payment: cash or PayNow; credit cards carry a 3% surcharge
- Areas served: Ang Mo Kio, Hougang, Yio Chu Kang, Serangoon, Bishan, Toa Payoh and the rest of Singapore

## Starting prices (SGD, include parts, labour and GST; final price confirmed after inspection)

- Car servicing (engine oil + filter): from $128 Japanese/Korean cars, from $148 Continental/European cars
- Major service: priced after inspection
- Car aircon gas top-up: from $20 (after a leak check)
- Car aircon chemical wash: from $120
- Aircon cooling coil replacement: from $600
- Aircon compressor replacement: from $550
- Brake pads: from $120 Japanese cars, from $140 Continental/European cars
- Car battery replacement: from $120; AGM battery from $250
- ABS pump repair: from $950; new ABS pump from $1,600
- Diagnosis: $30 if the customer does not go ahead with the repair
- Accident and insurance claim repair, spray painting: quoted after inspection

## Core services

- Car servicing: engine oil servicing, minor and major servicing, servicing for COE-age and parallel-import cars
- Mechanical repair: engine diagnosis, overheating and coolant leaks, misfiring, brakes, suspension and absorbers, battery, alternator and starter, transmission and CVT checks, timing belt, ABS faults
- Car aircon: not cold, gas leaks, cooling coil, compressor, condenser, expansion valve, blower and fan, smells
- Accident repair: insurance claims, panel beating, spray painting
- Makes covered: common Japanese, Korean and Continental cars (Toyota, Honda, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Subaru, Hyundai, Kia, BMW, Mercedes-Benz) and Tesla

## FAQ

### Where is Edwin Garage?
Blk 5032 Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2 #01-295, Singapore 569535.

### What are the opening hours?
Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm. Closed on Sundays.

### How much is car servicing at Edwin Garage?
From $128 for Japanese/Korean cars and from $148 for Continental/European cars, including parts, labour and GST. Final price after inspection.

### How much is a car aircon gas top-up?
From $20, after a leak check.

### Is Edwin Garage the same as SG Garage?
Yes. The website is sggarage.com and the company is Edwin Garage Automotive Services Pte. Ltd.

### Can I walk in?
No. Edwin Garage works by appointment only; book at https://sggarageedwin.as.me/.
